answer: One hash thread per identity: each epoch adds a violet-sealed link hashing the last link. A comet pass opens a window; the next link must post in time, locking a 70 bond and paying 12. Auditors replay the thread: a broken, reused or foreign link burns the bond, so a rented-link ring fails: borrowed links carry another key. Each fake pays 82: 1,000 fakes commit 82,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 12 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
